g.text: H-201 OUTLET VACUUM TRANSFER LINE TO C-201
1. Pipe/fittings/flanges per class B3 (CFU-000-PI-SPC-001); BW fittings ASME B16.9, flanges B16.5/B16.47A RF.
2. Hydrotest 25.2 barg per ASME B31.3 345.4 (vents at high points, drains at low points).
3. PWHT: YES - all thk (P-No.5B, B31.3 Tbl 331.1.1) 705-770 C. NDE: 100 % RT of BW; 100 % MT/PT of fillets; HB <= 241; 100 % PMI.
4. Supports: RS rest/shoe, GD guide, ANC anchor, SPR variable spring - tags PS-<area><seq>-nn.
5. Welds: dot = shop weld, crossed circle FW = field weld; spools <= 12 m for transport.
6. Vacuum transfer line: riser at heater then continuous fall 1:100 to C-201 (no liquid hold-up).
7. Large bore 54" for low velocity / flash-zone pressure; external-pressure (full vacuum) design.
8. Crosses rack at high level on transfer-line support structure TLS-201 (independent of rack).
9. Formal stress analysis mandatory; spring hangers on riser (heater + column growth).
